dedupe_keys.name: enhancing guidance for evacuation time estimate studies around nuclear plants nureg cr 7269

description: NUREG/CR-7269, Enhancing Guidance for Evacuation Time Estimate Studies, is an NRC contractor report prepared by researchers at Louisiana State University and Embry-Riddle Aeronautical University, completed in October 2019 and published in March 2020, that develops a technical basis for revising the NRC's evacuation time estimate criteria. Evacuation time estimates analyse the time to evacuate sectors and distances within the plume exposure emergency planning zone for permanent and transient populations, and every licensee must submit an update after each decennial census. The study built evacuation models for representative small, medium and large population zones and ran parametric analyses of traffic movement, including the impact of shadow evacuations, the effect of model extent, the effectiveness of manual traffic control and the significance of parameter values, and summarises insights to inform NRC staff. Coverage is generic U.S. plant sites. Access: a 13.46 MB PDF on the NRC page, free; no licence is stated. Caveats: representative, not site-specific models, with no model files on the page. It suits evacuation traffic simulation design, and relates to the NRC datasets on US nuclear facilities catalogued here.
